NoteThis information is in a short format, TL;DR.
Testing Chrome Policies Locally#Review the below for the key info for testing Chrome Policies locally before deploying via Intune.
Registry Key LocationsDevice-level policies (HKLM)#Machine-level policies apply to all users on the device and are stored under:
HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\ChromeUser-level policies (HKCU)#User-level policies apply only to the currently signed-in user and are stored under:
HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\ChromeViewing configured policies#To view the machine-level Chrome policies configured on a device, run:
Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome'To view user-level policies, run:
Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome'Finding Policy NamesOpen Chrome. In address bar, type, `Chrome://Policy’ and press Enter. Here, tick the box in the top right to show policies without settings. Click on any item name to discover more about the setting and options. Adding and Removing SettingsAdding\removing settings for local testing#$PolicyPath = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome' # Set policy Set-ItemProperty -Path $PolicyPath -Name 'IncognitoModeAvailability' -Value 1 -Type DWord # Remove policy (return to default) Remove-ItemProperty -Path $PolicyPath -Name 'IncognitoModeAvailability' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinueDeploying Google Chrome via Intune (MSI)#Review the below for deploying Chrome from Intune.
InstallationDownload the 64-bit Enterprise MSI from Google Chrome Enterprise. In Intune, navigate to Apps → Windows → Add. Select Custom App (Win32). Upload the MSI and configure the application details not picked up automatically or you want to customise. Assign to the required device or user groups. Intune handles installation automatically. Silent installation command (if required): msiexec /i "GoogleChromeStandaloneEnterprise64.msi" /qn /norestartDetectionIntune uses the MSI product code to detect installation. UpdatesChrome updates automatically through Google Update. No regular MSI redeployment is required. ConfigurationDeploy Chrome settings separately using an Intune Settings Catalog profile. Useful Settings to start with#Suggestions for settings# Google Chrome - Machine Policy Configuration $PolicyPath = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome' # Create registry key if it doesn't exist if (!(Test-Path $PolicyPath)) { New-Item -Path $PolicyPath -Force | Out-Null } # Helper function to set Chrome policies function Set-ChromePolicy { param ( [string]$Name, [object]$Value, [ValidateSet('DWord', 'String', 'MultiString')] [string]$Type = 'DWord' ) New-ItemProperty -Path $PolicyPath -Name $Name -Value $Value -PropertyType $Type -Force | Out-Null } # Approved extension IDs $ApprovedExtensionIds = @( # 'abcdefghijklmnopabcdefghijklmnop' ) # Approved URL blocklist $BlockedURLs = @( # 'example.com' ) # High Priority Set-ChromePolicy 'SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel' 2 # Enables Enhanced Safe Browsing protection Set-ChromePolicy 'DownloadRestrictions' 4 # Blocks malicious and dangerous downloads Set-ChromePolicy 'SSLErrorOverrideAllowed' 0 # Prevents users bypassing SSL certificate warnings Set-ChromePolicy 'SafeBrowsingProceedAnywayAllowed' 0 # Prevents users bypassing Safe Browsing warnings Set-ChromePolicy 'PasswordManagerEnabled' 0 # Disables Chrome Password Manager Set-ChromePolicy 'AutofillAddressEnabled' 0 # Disables address autofill Set-ChromePolicy 'AutofillCreditCardEnabled' 0 # Disables credit card autofill Set-ChromePolicy 'BrowserGuestModeEnabled' 0 # Disables Guest browsing Set-ChromePolicy 'IncognitoModeAvailability' 1 # Disables Incognito mode Set-ChromePolicy 'QuicAllowed' 0 # Disables the QUIC protocol Set-ChromePolicy 'RemoteDebuggingAllowed' 0 # Disables remote debugging Set-ChromePolicy 'BrowserLegacyExtensionPointsBlocked' 1 # Blocks legacy extension points Set-ChromePolicy 'DeveloperToolsAvailability' 2 # Disables Developer Tools Set-ChromePolicy 'DnsOverHttpsMode' 'off' 'String' # Disables DNS-over-HTTPS Set-ChromePolicy 'SyncDisabled' 1 # Disables Chrome Sync Set-ChromePolicy 'DynamicCodeSettings' 1 # Prevents the browser process creating dynamic code Set-ChromePolicy 'ApplicationBoundEncryptionEnabled' 1 # Enables application-bound encryption for stored secrets Set-ChromePolicy 'SitePerProcess' 1 # Enables site isolation for every site Set-ChromePolicy 'InsecurePrivateNetworkRequestsAllowed' 0 # Blocks insecure requests to more-private network endpoints Set-ChromePolicy 'CrossOriginWebAssemblyModuleSharingEnabled' 0 # Disables cross-origin WebAssembly module sharing Set-ChromePolicy 'NativeMessagingUserLevelHosts' 0 # Blocks user-level Native Messaging hosts Set-ChromePolicy 'AuthSchemes' 'ntlm,negotiate' 'String' # Restricts HTTP authentication to NTLM and Negotiate Set-ChromePolicy 'AIModeSettings' 1 # Disable Google's AI Mode integrations in the address bar and New Tab page search box Set-ChromePolicy 'AutofillGenAiSettings' 2 # Disable Google's Settings for generative AI features in Autofill # Block all extensions by default Set-ChromePolicy 'ExtensionInstallBlocklist' @('*') 'MultiString' # Blocks all extensions unless explicitly allowlisted # Allow approved extensions if ($ApprovedExtensionIds.Count -gt 0) { Set-ChromePolicy 'ExtensionInstallAllowlist' $ApprovedExtensionIds 'MultiString' # Allows approved extensions } # Block specified URLs if ($BlockedURLs.Count -gt 0) { Set-ChromePolicy 'URLBlocklist' $BlockedURLs 'MultiString' # Blocks specified website URLs } # Medium Priority Set-ChromePolicy 'BrowserSignin' 1 # Allows users to sign in to Chrome Set-ChromePolicy 'SafeBrowsingForTrustedSourcesEnabled' 1 # Enables Safe Browsing for trusted sources Set-ChromePolicy 'EncryptedClientHelloEnabled' 0 # Disables TLS Encrypted ClientHello Set-ChromePolicy 'EnableUnsafeSwiftShader' 0 # Disables software WebGL fallback using SwiftShader Set-ChromePolicy 'HttpsOnlyMode' 1 # Enables HTTPS-only mode Set-ChromePolicy 'MetricsReportingEnabled' 0 # Disables usage metrics reporting Set-ChromePolicy 'DefaultPopupsSetting' 2 # Blocks pop-ups by default Set-ChromePolicy 'DefaultGeolocationSetting' 2 # Blocks location access by default Set-ChromePolicy 'DefaultNotificationsSetting' 2 # Blocks notifications by default Set-ChromePolicy 'DefaultWebBluetoothGuardSetting' 2 # Blocks Web Bluetooth access by default Set-ChromePolicy 'DefaultWebUsbGuardSetting' 2 # Blocks Web USB access by default # Low Priority Set-ChromePolicy 'NTPContentSuggestionsEnabled' 0 # Disables New Tab page content suggestions Set-ChromePolicy 'BackgroundModeEnabled' 0 # Prevents Chrome running background apps after closing Set-ChromePolicy 'ImportSavedPasswords' 0 # Prevents importing saved passwords Set-ChromePolicy 'ImportAutofillFormData' 0 # Prevents importing autofill form data Set-ChromePolicy 'PrintingEnabled' 0 # Disables printing Set-ChromePolicy 'TranslateEnabled' 0 # Disables page translation # Display configured policies Get-ItemProperty $PolicyPath | Format-List
